capability_statement: AOF can read GitHub state without write authority and select the next most important task with Japanese evidence-backed reasoning.
before_state: The operator had to manually compare releases, issues, pull requests, Actions, and roadmap before deciding what AOF should do next.
after_state: AOF records a bounded read-only GitHub observation, candidate tasks, selected task, Go/No-Go, and explicit no-write boundaries.
scenario: Ask AOF to handle this repository and decide the next most important task from current GitHub and roadmap evidence.
five_minute_demo: Run github-readonly-observation-audit and inspect TASK-131-github-readonly-observation.json to see the selected task, evidence, and no-write boundary.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes manual cross-checking of latest release, open issues, open PRs, recent Actions, and roadmap before choosing the next task.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer needs to infer whether AOF had current GitHub context or whether write permission was implied.

capability_matrix.after: read-only observation selects one next task
capability_matrix.user_value: operator gets a Japanese evidence-backed next-task decision without granting write permission

not_proven: This does not prove GitHub writes, productivity gain, semantic truth, or external adoption.
